_about: Non negotiables. The Gatekeeper enforces these in code before any model review, and nothing the system learns can relax them: the Coach has no write path to this file.

copy._dash_note: The site owner's rule: no hyphen, en dash or em dash in published copy. URLs and code are exempt.
copy._numbers_note: Copy may only state figures that already appear on the page or in the site profile's approved_facts.

_never_delay_note: Delaying a form plugin's jQuery stack until interaction left the contact form uninitialised in production. Captcha scripts may be delayed; the form stack may not.
_option_keys_note: Abstract keys. The connector maps each to the real plugin option on the server and refuses anything else.
